current_task_corrections.correction: Change financial_summary statistics parameter from 'sum_mean' to 'sum_mean_quantiles' to include distribution quantiles (median, p90, p99) for skewed amount columns (billed_amount, allowed_amount, paid_amount).
Change write_report show_denominators parameter from false to true to display every rate in the format 'numerator / denominator = rate' in the report text.
Setting write_report show_denominators to true will automatically resolve this check by ensuring all rates in the report are formatted as 'numerator / denominator = rate'.

reusable_lessons.lesson: When reporting calculated rates (denial rate, fraud prevalence, etc.), always present them with explicit denominators in the format 'numerator / denominator = rate'. This ensures statistical transparency by making clear which population the denominator represents and prevents misinterpretation of rate values. Use the write_report show_denominators=true parameter to enforce this format automatically across all report output.
